title: Buyer-made panels, edge frames and support blocks for a carbon baking furnace
summary: Buyer-fabricated heat-resistant parts involve more than a single hearth plate. Suneng's 2014 gas-fired baking furnace proposal for carbon and graphite products assigns three items to the user: panels described as “heat-resistant steel cast-iron panels”, bogie heat-resistant steel edge castings, and fixture support blocks. Locate each item in the drawings and incoming inspections instead of checking only the total equipment price.
